messages.subject: Use the uploaded file in several tabpanels
parts:
Hello,

I really need some help with uploading file and use it as a reactive object, which I can then re-use across multiple tabpanels:

1) I wrote an reactive ({}) object to allow user upload file, this is stored as "Input_1"
2) I wrote this "Input_1" into another reactive ({}) object, where I use the uploaded file to carry out a series of calculations, this final product is "Output_1"

3) I want to output this "Output_1" across different tabpanels

But so far I got error:
before I upload the file, both Tabpanel shows "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"
after I upload the file, then the second Tabpanel can display properly, but the first one still has this error message.


Thanks so much!

Mao
